name: single leg squat with support
description: A one-leg squat using a support for balance, building strength in each leg.
instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor in front of you.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
